trial_court: Court of Sh. Nareesh Kumar Malhotra, District Judge (Commercial)-06, Tis Hazari Courts, West: Delhi, CS (Comm) No. 163/2024
case_name: Naresh Kumar Goyal vs Mansha Active Private Limited Through ... on 6 February, 2026

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Naresh Kumar Goyal, Proprietor of M/s. NKG Creations
parties.respondent_defendant: Mansha Active Private Limited, Through Director and Manoj Dua, Managing Director

facts_of_case: The plaintiff filed a suit for recovery of Rs. 1,00,00,000/- along with future pending lite interest against the defendants. The parties had a business agreement which was terminated and there was stock worth Rs. 1,08,25,183/- lying with the plaintiff.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to rely on a document to prove its authenticity.
legal_principles.held: This witness has admitted that the entire statement produced by him is system generated.

legal_principles.principle: A person's statement about their personal knowledge is not evidence.
legal_principles.held: This witness has stated that he has no personal knowledge about the ongoing litigation between the parties.

outcome.final_order: The court decided in favor of the plaintiff and ordered the defendants to pay the amount claimed along with future pending lite interest.
